content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil Nutramigen is a hypoallergenic infant formula based on extensively hydrolyzed cow’s milk protein, designed for infants with suspected food allergy or lactose intolerance. The ready‑to‑feed format provides precise dosing and convenience without any preparation.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula contains fully hydrolyzed protein, reducing the risk of allergic reactions.
Specifically developed for newborns and infants at high risk of atopy.
Includes prebiotic fibers (FOS) to support a healthy gut microbiome.
No water addition required, minimizing contamination risk.
Each container carries a batch‑tracking barcode for traceability and expiration monitoring.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Hydrolyzed protein and prebiotics help develop the infant’s immune system, especially in those prone to allergies.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: Extensively hydrolyzed protein is broken down more quickly in the gastrointestinal tract, reducing digestive load.

items.title: Balanced nutrition
items.content: The formula provides essential vitamins, minerals, and DHA for brain and eye development.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Suitable for infants with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Convenient use
items.content: Ready‑to‑feed eliminates the need for bottle sterilization and measuring volumes.

items.title: Cow‑milk protein allergy
items.content: Although the protein is hydrolyzed, some infants may still react to residual peptide fragments.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The formula contains a small amount of lactose; infants with complete intolerance should be monitored by a pediatrician.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: Once opened, the product should be used within 48 hours and kept refrigerated.

items.title: Feeding guidance
items.content: Do not replace breast milk entirely without pediatric advice.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Prepare a clean bottle, open the container and feed the ready‑to‑feed formula directly to the baby. If desired, warm to body temperature (about 37 °C) and test on the wrist. Do not leave the formula at room temperature for more than 2 hours.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, refrigerate and use within 48 hours. Discard if the product develops an off‑odor, color change, or unusual taste.
